scope: bounded static implementation review; no model forward or optimizer replay

checks.legal_views: full, food_only and water_only are generated from the inherited two-frame visual input; the masked view erases the hidden resource slot and existence bit in both frames.
checks.full_view_identity: The full view is checked against the inherited v0.28 cache before social training.
checks.dual_sender_roles: In dual conditions the food sender contributes the first token and the water sender the second; the receiver gets only the ordered two-token message.
checks.single_baseline: single_full uses one full-view sender with the original two-token communication API and the same two-resource reward.
checks.redundant_control: dual_same_full has two senders and the same receiver structure but gives both senders the full view.
checks.paired_conditions: All conditions use the same team-slot world indices and uniform streams; condition is omitted from fixture random seeds.
checks.balanced_roles: Four dual team slots make every agent receiver once and sender in each resource role once per update.
checks.no_truth_shortcut: Positions are passed only to the evaluator/loss after sampled actions; no position or goal enters sender or receiver inputs.
checks.formal_gate: Formal execution binds production source hashes and inherited input hashes to preflight_qa.json.
checks.fixed_budget: All formal runs use 2400 updates and no performance-based selection.

limitations: The four population members reuse two frozen private encoders and a fixed four-team schedule.
The complementary views are deterministic masks of the frozen visual input, not learned perceptual development.
The one-token-per-sender dual protocol tests component exchange in a controlled task, not a full language.
The bounded audit checks categorical endpoint and selected training traces, but not every gradient or Adam transition.
Offline token exchange and donor recombination do not establish autonomous online composition.
